description: Click the element identified by ref (from a snapshot) or selector. Options: button (left|right|middle, default left), clickCount (2 = double-click), force (bypass actionability), timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, target }. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND / SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (no such element — re-snapshot; not retryable, carries similar_refs), ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE (retryable), ELEMENT_DISABLED (not retryable), NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (ref+selector both/neither).

clickCount.description: Number of clicks (2 for a double-click). Default 1.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_click
title: Click an element
